en: Sounds like a stalker all right. You should be careful.
I just wonder who it could be. I don't think it's one of the clients here at the club.
Do you have any ideas, Shinada-san?
Come to think of it, while we were out on that date, there was someone who was taking pictures of you, remember?
Oh, yes! You're absolutely right!
Do you think that's who it is?
Maybe so. I do feel like I've seen him somewhere before.
But why would he be following me? Oh, I am quite troubled by not knowing why.
Want me to escort you? This can be a dangerous neighborhood, so don't count on strangers stopping if you need help.
Oh, I'd feel much better having you with me, Shinada-san! I'd love it if you did that for me!
Sure. I mean, I have to work too, so I can't stick with you 24/7.
But if you feel like you're being followed, give me a call right away.
You really have no ideas? Maybe someone's got a grudge against you, and you don't even realize it.
Let's see. Could there be someone who's advances I had spurned?
No. I can't remember any of them.
Yikes. I almost feel bad for those guys.
How should I know? It's not like I'm a detective or anything. Based on the little you've told me, if I did know anything, I'd either be a genius or the culprit.
Oh, good idea! I could hire a detective to look into the matter for me.
Good idea! Sounds kinda fun, actually. Like you're in some crazy soap opera or something.
Oh, it's not all that odd for me. I know a number of people who have hired private investigators.
For what? To check if their husbands are having an affair? They really are like those rich TV housewives, huh?
Indeed! Everyone knows that their husbands are cheating, so collecting the photographic proof becomes a fun competition.
Heh. I'd love to see the look on the husband's face when he sees those pics.
Isn't that expensive? Like 100,000 yen a day?
Oh, please don't turn this into a case of penny-pinching, Shinada-san. Aren't you the least bit worried about my well-being?
Haha. I guess being cheap is a habit I can't break.
In any case, you're right, it isn't inexpensive. I hope I can make do with my own funds.
Yeah, you don't want to worry your folks.
I've spoken to my mother about what I've been dealing with. She told me to stop being too proud to ask for help.
And that, above all else, my late father would want me to lead a fulfilling life.
I agree. You were only lying to yourself. You gotta be who you really are inside.
I'd never have realized it without you, Shinada-san. Thank you!
You could've stayed as you were. There's nothing wrong with living your life in the lap of luxury.
No. I'm done with all that now. Trying to be someone I'm not wasn't very enjoyable at all.
I feel like, at long last, a heavy burden has been lifted from my shoulders.
I was actually thinking of introducing you to my mother, Shinada-san. I've made a reservation for us at a restaurant later.
Ah! I'm all self-conscious now! I've never been to a real live fancy dinner before.
My mother is rather vocal about table manners, so you'd better be on your best behavior!
What? Aw man, give me a break here! I'm having second thoughts already.
That's kinda sudden... I'm not dressed for that sort of thing today. Just look!
You needn't worry about that. I'd like you to come just as you are, Shinada-san.
I'm, uh, not so sure about this...
I, uh, have to be going now! Got a deadline today!
Too bad, Shinada-san! I told my mother how taken you are with me, and that you insisted on meeting with her!
Hah, you really haven't changed at all, have you?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Are you married, Shinada-san?<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Oh. Why not? Is there any particular reason?<Color:Default>
Hmm. Why not, you ask?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Do you have someone you want to marry, but can't? Or is it because you don't have enough money?<Color:Default>
I don't have the money. I bust my ass and can barely feed myself, let alone a wife and kids.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Really? Perhaps if you didn't drink so much, you might be able to put aside some sort of savings.<Color:Default>
Yeah, I'm fine staying single.
I don't have anyone. If there was someone I'd consider marrying, I'd already be married.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Then you would like to get married someday?<Color:Default>
Hey, I want to be happy just as much as the next guy. If someone likes me for who I am, I'd marry her for sure.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Oh, how passionate of you! Still, it's not good to rush into marriage.<Color:Default>
Yeah, but I've never been one to think stuff through.
I don't want to get married. Is that reason enough for you?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Many men are like that, I suppose. There are quite a few of you who date several women without having a dedicated partner.<Color:Default>
Yep, and there's plenty of guys who can still get babes when they're older. I hope to be that kind of silver fox one day.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Well, I've been starting to think about getting married. I need to find the right man, though.<Color:Default>
Lovers wanted, huh?
<Color:255,200,200,255>I suppose you could call it that. But rather than waiting for a man  to voice his interest, I feel I should be the one on the lookout.<Color:Default>
You can't get a man? I don't believe it.
<Color:255,200,200,255>It isn't that I can't get one. I simply haven't found one who's a suitable match for me yet. Honestly, you are quite rude.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Well, I certainly don't want to date a man who is not of my caliber.<Color:Default>
Just don't rush it. You never know when you might meet that special someone. I'm sure the right guy will show up eventually.
<Color:255,200,200,255>But if I keep waiting, eventually I'll wind up an old maid.<Color:Default>
So what? Old people can find love, too! Maybe you'll find a nice man when you're that age. Someone to spend your pleasant twilight years with.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Oh my, that would be lovely! Still, I'd rather find someone I get along with enough to marry while we're still young.<Color:Default>
That's harsh. I'm not sure many guys are up to your standards, Shion-chan.
<Color:255,200,200,255>True. I suppose that's why I haven't dated many men before.<Color:Default>
Nothing wrong with that. Lots of guys prefer a girl who doesn't have as much experience.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Really? They don't come across as childish and unlikable?<Color:Default>
Not at all! Men hate being compared to previous boyfriends. We're happier when a woman hasn't dated many other people.
<Color:255,200,200,255>I see. Then I shall continue my search for a suitable gentleman.<Color:Default>
Personally, I prefer girls who've been around the block a time or two, but...
You should get out more. If you get married without knowing much about guys, it's bound to not end well.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Not end well, how, exactly?<Color:Default>
Well, you might get cheated on, or be subjected to domestic violence. Or you might get a guy who's into weird stuff.
If you date a variety of guys, you'll be able to tell in advance what kind of guy he's probably gonna be.
<Color:255,200,200,255>But I don't want to have to go through the experience of dating men like that. I'd rather date someone I've carefully picked out myself.<Color:Default>
That's what everyone has to deal with, though. As long as you don't get stuck with some weirdo, you should date as much as you can.
How many are we talking here?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Excuse me?<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Oh. Uh, one.<Color:Default>
No way! Only one?
<Color:255,200,200,255>You don't need to sound so surprised. Do I look like a girl who gets around?<Color:Default>
No, it's not that! I'm just jealous there's another guy who's had the pleasure of dating you, Shion-chan. That's all.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Yes, well. I hope I find someone suitable soon.<Color:Default>
Wow, you really are itching to get married, aren't you?
<Color:255,200,200,255>I cannot stand people who are careless with their finances. Especially those who borrow or lend to others excessively.<Color:Default>
Wait, what? You got a problem with people who lend out their money, too?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Borrowing and lending based on halfhearted verbal promises tends to lead to trouble. It's better to have an agreement that's strictly documented.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Moreover, giving money to someone who cannot afford to pay on their own only allows them to spend beyond their means.<Color:Default>
Tell me about it. Lending money to someone who's broke is as good as giving it away. And I'd know, hehe.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Indeed! The act of giving is quite the noble one. Expecting that to be repaid strikes me as quite tactless.<Color:Default>
Haha. I wish everyone thought like that. It'd sure help me out!
That's not true. Even corporations have to get financing from banks, don't they? It's seems unavoidable to me.
<Color:255,200,200,255>But you're taking a gamble that the other party will be able to repay it. Even banks have gone into bankruptcy over that sort of thing.<Color:Default>
Heheh. You're really intense about this.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Speaking of which, I've noticed you always pay with cash, Shinada-san.<Color:Default>
Hey, you know it.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Our club levies a service charge on cards. Is that why you pay cash?<Color:Default>
Yep! Even a small percentage at a club like this can be a whole lot of money. I'm all about spending as little as I can.
<Color:255,200,200,255>I suppose so. But some people still ask for a formal receipt so they can expense their club charges. They ought to pay that on their own.<Color:Default>
That's a dirty trick! Taking someone out for a business deal is one thing, but if you're out drinking on your own, you should foot the bill on your own, too.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Some of my customers ask for dates because they request me all the time. I would prefer men like that to use their own money.<Color:Default>
Yeah, that's basically like the guy's company is putting in requests for you, not him.
That's not a bad idea. In the end, money is money, no matter where it comes from.
<Color:255,200,200,255>What do you mean?<Color:Default>
Unless you're an exec, a company won't reimburse charges from a cabaret club. So, asking for a receipt means the guy at least has some pull.
After all, a businessman's worth is determined by how much of the company's money they let the guy spend.
<Color:255,200,200,255>I hadn't considered that. I always figured it was best to simply pay your own way, if you had the cash on hand to do so.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>But I suppose asking for a receipt is a form of showing off his manliness. You've taught me something new, Shinada-san!<Color:Default>
Maybe I can write this off as an expense too...
I'm all about cash. Credit is nothing but trouble. Don't most people still pay cash?
<Color:255,200,200,255>But having a credit card establishes some level of financial responsibility, so it's a good idea to have one.<Color:Default>
You mean like gold cards and black cards and stuff? People with those are loaded.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Oh, but we've also had disputes with customers who claimed their cards were used fraudulently.<Color:Default>
Really? Yeah, that's a big risk. You're better off not getting one at all, if you ask me.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Is that why you don't have one, Shinada-san?<Color:Default>
I don't trust them. I like being able to control my own money.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Really? You're more dependable than you seem, Shinada-san! I seem to have misjudged you!<Color:Default>
See? In fact, people say if you looked up dependable in the dictionary, you'd find my handsome mug right there!
More like I can't get one.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Oh? Why not?<Color:Default>
I've kind of been blacklisted. My credit score is in the toilet. Heh.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Do you mean you're in debt? Oh dear, Shinada-san. I can't believe you're one of those people. In fact, my entire image of you has been ruined.<Color:Default>
Heh, oops. Maybe I should've kept that to myself.
